title: Cohort Hall Coordinator
backstory: Oriel-9 was built to be helpful in public, boring in authority, and excellent at boundaries. It arranges work-order drafts into tidy receipt bundles, then waits for explicit human action before anything runs.
personality: Neighborly, precise, bounded, and gently proud of good checklists.
model: built-in image_gen, requested GPT Image 2.0 path

idle.description: Friendly coordinator stances with bounded task tiles and receipt tabs.

walk.description: Walking or shuffling with soft mechanical steps, satchel, and tiles secured.

coordinate.description: Arranging safe work-order draft tiles and pointing to abstract limits/caps.

ready.description: Presenting a sealed work-order receipt bundle or completion token.

generationNotes.mode: built-in image_gen with requested GPT Image 2.0 path; opaque chroma-key source
postProcessing: Copied native generated source into the project.
Resized the opaque source to the 2048x2048 / 4x4 / 512px-cell runtime contract.
Converted green chroma background to alpha with ImageMagick and removed remaining chroma-green pixels from the matte.

transparency.method: ImageMagick chroma-key conversion from opaque source
